investigations.name: glazier-graner-sorting
investigations.title: Reproducing Glazier & Graner (1993) differential-adhesion cell sorting
investigations.question:
Does the pbg-artistoo wrapper over the Artistoo Cellular Potts Model reproduce the
differential-adhesion-driven rearrangements of Glazier & Graner (1993) — cell sorting /
engulfment (Fig 12), checkerboard intercalation (Fig 7), and the high-temperature mixing
transition (Fig 9) — from the paper's own surface-tension energies, with no cell motility?
investigations.hypothesis:
Driven only by relative surface tensions gamma (finite-temperature Metropolis dynamics, no
active migration), the heterotypic boundary fraction of a mixed two-type aggregate should FALL
when the heterotypic tension is positive (sorting), RISE when it is negative (checkerboard), and
fail to sort cleanly at high temperature (mixing). Each regime is reproduced by the wrapper's
registered composite for the matching paper figure, robust across seeds.
